hero.title: Organize your links. Share what matters.
hero.subtitle: Linkfolio helps you collect the links you care about, group them into tidy collections, and share them with anyone - no clutter, no noise.

save.title: Save your links
save.description: Keep every link you want to revisit in one calm, organized place.

organize.description: Group related links into collections that make sense to you.

share.title: Share with anyone
share.description: Publish a collection and share it with a single link, no account required.
